method: Independent reconstruction of material IDs, layer grouping/recipes, resource intervals, trajectories and ledger; not engine self-validation

checks.name: all record IDs are unique
finite input material exists
all eighteen production stations are exercised
all six lanes are exercised
layer IDs are unique
layers contain forty unique good bricks and ordered process times
completed pallets are fourteen FIFO layers / 560 unique good bricks with valid recipes
completed pallet layers contact the indexed pallet deck and each other
storage and handoff runners contact the floor with all layers supported
both layer positions are actually reached on the physical buffer bed
loaded truck pallets never overwrite occupied positions
loaded forklift transports and insertions preserve the signed load-center frame
occupied resource calendars have no conflicting owners
occupied-zone evidence is not empty
two-position buffer occupancy and FIFO reconstructed independently
material tracks are finite, continuous and non-overlapping
routing swept footprint uses deck support and upstream bridge
material ledger transactions are available
all material ownership transitions conserve unique identities
representative layer-transfer events exist
representative completed-pallet events exist
skip exchange exercised
skip exchange drains collection, stops admissions, proves stow and retains removed material
original replay is not a run input
north/south kiln-cart tracks retain fixed X and yaw
finite source cart has all original IDs on its support tray
source picks top-down forty-brick layers and rotates them rigidly ninety degrees
partial cart is retained and source delivery causally precedes inspection
engine leaves the shared geometry object immutable
run identifies the authoritative manifest hash

limitations: Logical interlocks and authored support geometry only; not industrial drive/structural qualification.
Finite sample sweeps do not certify continuous rigid-body collision/contact or friction.
Hooklift vehicle selection, swept paths, payload, impact and dust handling remain hardware assumptions.
